name: Peipehsuchus
sum: Peipehsuchus is a metriorhynchoid crocodyliform known from China and fragmentary remains from Kyrgyzstan.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Remains from the Balabansai Formation (Kyrgyzstan) and the Tzeliuching Formation (China).
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Young 1948
